name: Globetrot
summary: A region and currency picker in a shop header: a dotted globe flies to your country and prices roll over
about: The deliver-to button of a home goods shop opens a panel with a dotted globe, a search box and eight countries with their local time. Choose one and the globe zooms out, turns along a glowing great-circle flight to the new city and drops a gold pin with ripples, the button flips to the new code, then every price rolls over digit by digit in the new currency and the delivery date updates. Language and format switches number and date style between Pakistan, UK and US English.
how: Click the region button in the header to open the panel.
Click a country, or type to filter and use the up and down arrows with Enter.
Change Language and format to see dates and numbers in another English style.
Escape or a click outside closes the panel; a demo plays until you click, tap or press a key.
